property_summary: For any bytes4 interface id x, C.supportsInterface(x) is true or C.supportsInterface(type(IERC165).interfaceId) is true (ERC165 support is always reported); the mutant drops the ERC165 disjunct, so for most fuzzed ids both are false and the rule fails.
change_summary: Remove the super.supportsInterface disjunct so IERC165 is no longer supported.
